category.description: Category slug for the search (e.g., 'music', 'business', 'food-and-drink', 'sports'). Combined with location.
category.title: Category (optional)

location.description: City/region slug to use when no startUrls are provided. Format: 'ny--new-york', 'ca--san-francisco', 'united-states', 'online'.
location.title: Location (optional)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of events to return.
maxItems.title: Max Items

startUrls.description: Eventbrite browse URLs (e.g., https://www.eventbrite.com/d/ny--new-york/all-events/). Any filters in the URL are preserved.
startUrls.title: Start URLs
